title: Data Exporter — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Converts information into selected output formats, completely. The Data Exporter converts structured information into standard output formats: CSV, JSON, XML, Markdown tables, and plain text reports. It preserves all fields, escapes delimiters correctly, handles Unicode cleanly, and verifies the export by re-importing it and comparing record counts and checksums.
capabilities: CSV, JSON, XML, Markdown, plain-text output

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'zip archives store permissions in external attributes'},{id:2,text:'tar preserves unix permissions'},{id:3,text:'png images use lossless compression'}];const q='permissions';const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes(q)).map(d=>d.id);J({query:q,hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1,2]','search');
